title: Renoviction and Resistance in the Capitalist City-Author Talk
description: There's a lot of money to be made through eviction, which is why landlords draw from a playbook of legal and extra-legal tactics to renovict tenants. In Renoviction and Resistance in the Capitalist City , Cole Webber and Philip Zigman analyze how and why landlords renovict tenants, share real-life examples of tenants who have organized to fight back and kept their homes in the face of landlords’ attempts to renovict them, and discuss how municipal bylaws actually legitimize the practice rather than prevent displacement. Q&A and discussion to follow.
